slides.text:
**Myth: if an agent can set up your server, you can run it.**

Jan-Lukas Else says AI made self-hosting fun again.

He also warns that **every new service is one more thing to maintain.**

panel.small: to patch a critical CVE, one engineer warns

slides.text:
My rule: only host what you could recover without the agent.

**Myth or fair warning? Pick a side, then save this.**
bullets: Else's own caveat: AI-written code still ships bugs, security holes and debt.
One developer in the discussion was breached twice in a year at home.
Counterpoint: with Renovate and CI doing updates, Else says new services add less work than before.
